title: Needs to keep improving.
body:
1. Return to previous (used when made a mistake) works when it wants to. Works Intermittently. 

2. Add a button to switch from lower, title, and upper case.

3. Once an image is inserted, make it able to copy and then paste the image as many times as desired.

4. Make it capable to paste a formula to remaining cells of a column by clicking on the cross on lower right corner of cell as done in excel.

5. Add more colors (and/or any other more option) to conditional formatting to be able to distinguish more variables of a dropdown menu for instance.

6. When a graph is inserted using info from a column, column where each cell has a dropdown menu, make the graph show the variables with the same colors that the user used to distinguish each variable of the dropdown menu. 

Example. On a column where each cell has a dropdown menu, where you can choose between 1, 2, and 3. The user decides to use conditional formatting where 1 is highlighted green, 2 is highlighted yellow, and 3 red.

When a graph is inserted using the info of this same column, please make the graph show the same colors for 1, 2, and 3 as the ones chosen by the user from conditional formatting to the dropdown menu. 
This will aid the understanding of the graph by matching colors.
